name: Pepperpot Town
chat: I come for the fountain. I stay for the fries.
They say Lanternhall City sells everything. Even rain.
Try the lemonade at the cart!
The food truck moves every day. Today it’s right here.

props.say: Café: “Our coffee is fair trade. Our prices are not.”
Food truck: “Billie burgers! (No Billies were harmed.)”
